run_eval_main: run the main evaluation function for action anticipation with config args and optional resume
train_one_epoch: train one epoch of action anticipation classifier on video data with verb-noun labels
validate: validate action anticipation model on validation set and return accuracy and recall metrics
load_checkpoint: load a training checkpoint restoring classifiers optimizer state and scaler for resuming training
test_main: test the main eval function with action anticipation config args for EK100 dataset evaluation
